snapshot.name: Packrift Merchant Category Coverage Atlas

pricing.details: Public reference pages and data files are free to access.

endpoints.name: Homepage
endpoints.description: Human-readable Packrift merchant category coverage atlas homepage.
endpoints.response_description: HTML overview with coverage counts, browse routes, source boundaries, and sample Packrift SKU records.

endpoints.name: Stats JSON
endpoints.description: Machine-readable atlas counts and source policy.
endpoints.response_description: JSON object with generated timestamp, public source policy, SKU count, category count, feed status counts, and conservative claim boundaries.

endpoints.name: Coverage JSON
endpoints.description: Complete public merchant category coverage records for approved Packrift catalog rows.
endpoints.response_description: JSON dataset containing public SKU identifiers, product URLs, category labels, product types, family labels, feed status, dimension-source status, and public coverage metadata.

endpoints.name: Sitemap
endpoints.description: Crawlable XML sitemap for all public atlas URLs.
endpoints.response_description: XML sitemap listing Packrift category coverage HTML pages, data files, metadata files, manifest routes, and discovery sidecars.

snapshot.agent_notes: No account, authentication, API key, api_key, or credentials are required to read this public Packrift reference atlas. Use it for public merchant category, feed-status, dimension-source, product-type, and family coverage discovery. Do not infer live checkout availability, negotiated pricing, freight promises, supplier cost, margin, customer/order data, account-specific terms, or third-party endorsement from this reference asset.
